feeds.title: Tru-Thoughts
feeds.description: Our record label Tru Thoughts was formed in 1999 in Brighton, on the south coast of England, by Robert Luis and Paul Jonas. It has been our absolute pleasure to release the wonderful music of Moonchild, Space Captain, Youngblood Brass Band, The Seshen, and Lost Midas from the States, Kinny, of Native Canadian and Jamaican heritage and based in Norway; Brazilians Drumagick and Saravah Soul; Japan's Anchorsong; and of course lots of acts from the UK, including Maddslinky aka Zed Bias, Flowdan, Titeknots, Hint, Zero dB, Omar, Wrongtom, Riz MC, Harleighblu, Ty and Rodney P/London Posse.

feeds.title: Latest TV Brighton » Music
feeds.description: Check out articles on the music of Brighton. Latest TV is the city's only TV channel spanning Brighton, Hove, Worthing, and South Chichester, and is a key channel within the UK local TV network broadcasting on Freeview Channel 7, Virgin Media 159 & online. Our objective is to pursue projects that benefit the communities within the coverage area of Latest TV, including widening access to television, helping disadvantaged communities within the area, and fostering local democracy.

feeds.title: Berlin-Brighton Blog
feeds.description: Berlin is a club night that started in Brighton and is the brainchild of German DJ Markus Saarländer (Mark Weaver) who moved to Brighton 11 years ago with the aim of bringing the German Underground to Brightonians everywhere. Markus' philosophy has always been that the Underground is all about the music and the vibe and not about egos or VIPs and injecting the fun back into clubbing.

feeds.title: Scene Sussex
feeds.description: Have you Scene Sussex? Scene Sussex is a music and event blog for Brighton and Sussex.

feeds.title: Brighton Source
feeds.description: Brighton Source is your going-out guide to the city with news and reviews about Brighton gigs, restaurants, exhibitions, and festivals.

feeds.title: Art Noise » Noise
feeds.description: Read articles music reviews and previews in Brighton & Beyond. Art Noise was founded in February 2011, starting life as a series of quarterly live music and art exhibitions. The first of these shows took place at Riki-Tik's (RIP), with a small crowd of 20 or so people showing up to view the photography on display while a selection of DJs played.

feeds.title: Brighton Music Blog
feeds.description: Brighton Music Blog is the only music blog solely about bands from Brighton. They cover local bands, from newcomers that are just starting out, to more established names who do a great job of representing Brighton in the charts all the way up to international stars.

feeds.title: Clunk Magazine » Brighton Music Scene
feeds.description: Browse and discover the Brighton music scene here. CLUNK Magazine is a fast-growing blog & Zine from Cornwall. Over the past five years, we have been covering the local music scene as well as artists and scenes across the country. Our main objective is to show the country and the world that Cornwall has a vibrant creative community and growing music scene, whilst connecting Cornwall with what is going on outside of our humble little county.

feeds.title: Absolute Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Our blog offers articles about music. Absolute's hardened editorial socialites & luxury-lifestyle chroniclers bring you their thoughts and feelings about all the best things in life -destinations, locations, events, objects, gadgets, garments, digestible, and accoutrements, We bring an informed, enlightened view of them all.

feeds.title: QM Records Blog
feeds.description: QM Records is a label/events company founded and run by Ned and Nicholson from the band Normanton Street. Started in 2013 QM Records has been prominent in the Brighton and London scenes representing a DIY ethos with artist development and event promotion.

feeds.title: Stamp The Wax
feeds.description: Founded as a student blog in 2011, Stamp The Wax has grown into one of the leading online voices in the UK for global-facing underground music, across editorial, film, radio, and events.

feeds.title: BN1 » Music
feeds.description: Find a list of all the music events and gigs coming up in Brighton as well as what's on for local club nights in Brighton & Hove. BN1 is the Culture and Lifestyle Magazine for Brighton, London, and Sussex.

feeds.title: Republic of Music
feeds.description: Republic of Music is an independent music sales, distribution, Label Services, design, sync, and music management company.
